title: Neow's Talisman
description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: When obtained, automatically upgrades one Strike card and one Defend card from your deck (the last ones in the deck order). Both must be present for the effect to trigger—if either Strike or Defend cards are missing, only the available card is upgraded.
